summary: Ending the run here: every registered question is answered, no gaps or uncited executions remain, and the two and a half minutes available cannot support an experiment plus the interpretation that would make it evidence, so I add nothing rather than pad the record. The session's substantive results, each with retained receipts, declared comparisons, witnesses and stated limits: the RestoreCommittedLogs startup replay blocks NewRaft through a blocking FSM-channel send issued before the FSM goroutine exists and before any handle is returned, once the replay window exceeds 128 batches; VerifyLeader counts nonvoter acknowledgements toward a voter quorum, so a leader separated from every other voter but still reaching a nonvoter is confirmed, and under per-node timers that confirmation outlived a competing leader's election in twenty of twenty trials and coincided with committed state the confirming leader had never applied in twelve of twelve, while uniform clusters kept the separation down to a one-millisecond margin; and AddVoter installs a Voter immediately against two published descriptions that promise staging, which can strand a single-voter cluster until the added server runs. Five suspicions were refuted with evidence, one behaviour entry was corrected under its own id with its affected use answered, and the surviving findings carry the narrowings that later measurements forced on my own earlier readings.
